brief: The canvas presents a dynamic cosmic flow of interconnected, vibrant shapes. These structures are defined by crystalline facets that emit a steady internal luminescence, casting visible, deep shadows onto the connected surfaces. The overall flow constantly cycles through states of energetic chaos, moving toward momentary balance before dissolving back into entropy. The shapes shift and reform perpetually, creating a mesmerizing, three-dimensional cycle that continuously changes without any input from the viewer.
